latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor AI Mac 1.0.0

- Initial release for Mac users and content creators: AI-powered video editing and exporting via a simple prompt and upload.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB) with seamless handling of Mac/iPhone clips.
- Automatic session and token management — 100 free credits for new users.
- Easy workflow: upload video, describe your edit (e.g., “cut the boring parts, add transitions”), and download 1080p MP4.
- Clear error handling for common issues (token, credits, file type, export).
- No complex UI — all commands via chat, mapped directly to cloud API actions.
